compiled_state.title: REVIEW-WORKFLOW: review comment remediation does not invoke TDD cycle -> fixes committed without RED test
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 17277411ae13e87e0bd6e9e4cde0d8e14c87f0f1
* **Context Scope:** PR review response workflow — sustained findings from dso_ci_review cycle 1

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per CLAUDE.md rule 16: "Every code change requires a corresponding test that fails before the change (RED) and passes after (GREEN)." This rule applies to all code changes, including fixes applied in response to reviewer findings. The REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md autonomous resolution loop (R1–R5) does not document a TDD requirement for fix steps.

When a reviewer finding is sustained and a code fix is required, the workflow must author a RED test before implementing the fix, then confirm the test goes GREEN after the fix.

#### Actual Behavior

When remediating sustained reviewer findings (e.g., Finding 3: Python artifact write failure; Finding 4: invalid hook type in reinstall-hooks.sh; Finding 5: silent corrupt token), fixes are implemented directly without a RED test phase. A test was added for Finding 3 only after the fix was already committed, by user request — not as a required workflow step. Findings 4 and 5 received no tests.

The REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md R1–R5 autonomous resolution loop has no TDD gate: it describes "fix → re-review" but not "RED test → fix → GREEN → re-review."

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Fixed Finding 3 (commit-step.sh Python failure) — fix committed first, test added after user asked "is there a test case?"
  * Fixed Finding 4 (reinstall-hooks.sh invalid hook type) — no test written
  * Fixed Finding 5 (override.token warning) — no test written
* **Known Workarounds:** None; user must manually ask "is there a test?"

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md autonomous resolution loop (R1–R5)
* **Skills Invoked:** `/dso:review`, `dso:code-reviewer-*` pipeline

comments.body: Fixed: Added explicit TDD requirement block to REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Autonomous Resolution Loop. Changes: (1) Added 'TDD REQUIREMENT' callout with RED/UPDATE/GREEN definitions and orchestrator verification duty — parallel to the INLINE FIX PROHIBITION block. (2) Updated Architecture description to include 'TDD cycle' in resolution sub-agent role. (3) Added mandatory TDD compliance check step between FIXES_APPLIED receipt and re-review dispatch, including explicit re-dispatch instruction when green-only TESTING_MODES is detected for behavioral fixes. File changed: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
